items.title: Anime upscale
items.text: Anime only: the TV's Super Resolution and gradation tuned for drawn pictures on the way to 4K, then put back. Settings › Playback.

items.title: Every title in its own language
items.text: Films and series start in the language you choose whenever the file has it, anime in Japanese. Settings › Audio.

items.title: Smarter search
items.text: Your recent searches, an Arabic keyboard, and spelling slips forgiven.

items.title: Skip, on a timer
items.text: The skip button leaves by itself after five seconds, a line showing the time left.

items.title: Reduce motion
items.text: Quicker moves and stiller pages for a slower TV. Settings › Appearance.

items.title: Reset all settings
items.text: Every setting back as it came, your account and library untouched. Settings › About.
